name: Yua
source:
Yua is the goddess that came out of Your Diary who is searching for Tomoki’s happiness, and is also the writer of Your Diary and records every day’s events in the book. She’s an energetic girl who gets on well with everyone. She also gets teased by everyone quite a lot due to her childishness. 

She lives in Yuuhi’s house and sleeps in her room since [url=/c2641]Yuuhi[/url] didn’t want another girl to sleep in Tomoki’s room. She also loves cats.

[spoiler]At the end of Hotori's route, Yua disappears.[/spoiler]

[Edited and taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/12/14/your-diary-review/]Liemyx's review[/url]]
